name: Ontario Mills
description: Ontario Mills is one of California's largest outlet and value retail shopping destinations, featuring over 200 stores spanning 1.7 million square feet. This popular enclosed mall offers an extensive mix of outlet stores from premium brands, entertainment venues including a movie theater and arcade, and diverse dining options, attracting shoppers from across Southern California and beyond.
summary: Southern California's premier outlet shopping destination featuring over 200 brand-name stores and entertainment options in a massive 1.7 million square foot enclosed mall.
